model: MIT pinned UNet3D [8,16,32], 62103 parameters; same dense adapter
data_selection: 1000 train and 256 val original sorted source tiles, official split archive00; no original files transformed
selection_metric: validation macro-F1 across all seven semantic channels
training_budget: 40 epochs, batch8, AdamW .003 cosine .0001; half uniform + half class-presence patch sampling, inverse-sqrt class weighted occupied voxel CE
inference_features: occupancy,count/16,local_z/32,mean_intensity/65535; no reference labels, RGB, NIR or label-derived height
past_test_use: R1 32 test00 tiles already scored after R1 model freeze; retained as consumed regression, not fresh evidence
fresh_test_reservation: After expanded model freeze ONLY: 256 evenly spaced sorted members of official test01 archive; no access before freeze

fresh_quality_gates.all_seven_test_coverage: Each class requires positive test support; absence is NOT_RUN for full-seven coverage
fresh_quality_gates.numerical: FP32 ONNX max_abs <.001, FP16 RMSE<.03, point-label agreement>=.995; report actual failures

baselines: fixed geometry-only: local 5m XY minimum terrain, 25m minimum filter; ground H<=.5m, building H>2m and 2m cell Z std<.5m, vegetation otherwise; no label fitting
